title: Official account
items: Messages from the official Bliscord account show an OFFICIAL tag
The official Bliscord chat is read only

title: GIFs and announcements
items: GIF picker next to the send button with search, trending and categories
Star any GIF to save it to your favorites, including GIFs people send in chat
Text channel names can use emojis and symbols
Create a rules channel directly, or set one from channel settings or the right-click menu
Follow an announcement channel to get its posts in a channel of your own server
Switch a text channel to an announcement channel and back
New announcements notify you, with a switch in Notifications settings
Announcement channels no longer open to a blank screen

title: Roles, permissions and profile styles
items: Roles with colors, permissions, ordering and separate member list groups
Categories, announcement channels, a rules channel and a welcome message channel
Private channels and per-channel permissions for any role or member
Slowmode, voice channel user limits, bans, server mute, server deafen and disconnect
Mention roles with @RoleName
Profile themes, animated avatar decorations, profile effects and name styles
Upload your own background image for any theme
Stereo microphone option that everyone in the call hears
Screen share audio no longer lights up the speaking ring
The calling sound no longer plays again when the other person leaves a call, and their tile goes away

title: Sharper streams
items: Screen shares and webcams look much sharper, starting at full quality instead of warming up
Screen share sends your game or video audio in stereo, separate from your mic and without noise suppression
Right-click someone's stream to change its volume, mute its audio or hide it
Webcams now send in 1080p
Profile badges and verified checkmarks
Update and news popups like this one

title: Bliscord is here
items: Servers, channels, direct messages and friends
Voice channels, calls, webcams and screen sharing
Profiles with avatars, banners, bios and custom status
Dark, Light, Midnight, Liquid Glass and Frost Glass themes
